label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~80) after a rewarded trial, when choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), only in the last ~20 trials of the 100-trial episode (zero activity before trial 70, rate 8-11% in trials 80-99), almost only when the previous trial was rewarded (99% of mass), and mostly when the agent picks a1 (93% of mass; the model policy argmax at GO is used, an observed/computed variable, rather than the future action column, which scores almost identically). Magnitude grows toward the episode end and with low value-head output (value < 5.22 holds 78% of mass; value falls as the episode end nears): activations increase trial by trial within a window. It does not fire after unrewarded trials, at a2 choices (small residual), or before trial ~75. Misses are mostly weak activations at trials 75-80 and small a2 activations.

issues: Reproduced the reported test scores for the predicate: P 0.861, R 0.848, F1 0.854, mass recall 0.903.
Phase claim holds: all 22543 active dev steps are at GO, none at D1 or D2.

Trial-position claim holds: zero activations in trials 0-69, rate 0.7% in trials 70-79, 7.9% in 80-89, 11.1% in 90-99. Within the predicate, trials 90+ have precision 0.97, while the onset band (trials 80-89) has precision 0.77, so most false positives come from the ramp-up near the cutoff. The explanation already says this.
Reward claim holds: prev_reward == 1 carries 99.3% of activation mass. Firing after unrewarded trials in trials 80+ has precision 0.02.

Choice claim holds: model_act == 1 carries 93% of mass (11.8% firing rate vs 0.9% for a2). The same predicate with a2 instead of a1 scores precision 0.07 and mass 0.09 on test, so a2 activations are a small, low-precision residue, not a separate pattern I could isolate.

The feature is not about the good state: adding good == 1 drops test-side recall to 0.71. A logit threshold (choice > 2) in place of model_act == 1 gives the same test F1 (0.855), and the future action column gives 0.851. The label using the agent's own choice is justified.
Value claim holds: value < 5.22 plus a1 gives precision 0.97 but recall 0.42, matching the stated alternative.
The test misses list shows no systematic class beyond the stated ones (weak activations near trials 75-80 and small a2 activations).
